{{Quote|Now look what you've made me do. It's ruined. ''[Klatooinian exclaims]'' I mean, it looks perfect to me, sir.|The droid to a customer|<ref name="SC 102" />}}
A '''tattoo artist droid''' operated on [[Borgo Prime]] around [[9 ABY]]. They were present when [[SM-33]], [[Wim]], [[Neel]], [[Fern]], and [[KB]] attempted to escape [[Vane]] as he and other [[pirate]]s chased them through the [[spaceport]].

==Biography==
The [[droid]] was a [[8D-series smelter droid]]<ref name="SC 102 EG" /> model who served as a [[tattoo]] artist aboard the [[shadowport]] [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]] during the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Era|Era]]. While in the middle of one session<ref name="SC 102" /> around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> as they were tattooing the [[Desilijic]] insignia on the upper arm of a [[Klatooinian]],<ref name="SC 102" /> the [[Skeleton Crew]]<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> [[youngling]]s—[[Wim]], [[Neel]], [[Fern]], and [[KB]]—barged into the kiosk along with the droid [[SM-33]], running away from a hostile [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]]<ref name="SC 102" /> and other thugs.<ref name="SC 102 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> SM-33 crashed into the tattoo artist, causing them to mess up their work. Originally complaining about having his work ruined, the droid took on a softer tone when the client started to make a fuss and said the tattoo ultimately looked perfect to them.<ref name="SC 102" />

==Personality and traits==
Being a droid and therefore lacking skin, the droid could not tattoo itself in the traditional sense. Their plating was instead covered in a variety of soldered "tattoos."<ref name="SC 102 EG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tattoo artist droid debuted in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' live-action television series,<ref name="SC 102" /> which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
